name: truce_cold
note: Cold map style of the Truce 1914 episode: palette proposed from the batch2 film_look frames (preset_from_frames), chosen by the creator 2026-11-20 (card 'C cold'); font from the episode film (creator card 'film font').

measured: palette (k-means, 8 clusters in Lab, equal weight per frame)
proposal_notes.line_stroke_source: no warm saturated cluster in the frames: Okabe-Ito vermillion (fixed, colour-blind safe)
derived: map.* and hud.* colours: ink = darkest cluster (L<=28), paper = lightest (L 78-90, chroma x0.6), water = bluest mid cluster (chroma x0.5, L 68), line.stroke = most saturated warm mid-dark cluster (else vermillion), counter_value = bluest dark cluster at L 30; blends of ink/paper for land cover, roads, borders, waterways
fixed: line widths, boundary dash, land cover opacity, grain size 300 (not measured)
font: empty on purpose, a person chooses it
